messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning to publish py & ts SDKs in the 02:00-04:00 UTC change window tonight. Need a final pin policy, canary cohort, and rollback criteria. Who's on shiproom?
sam: I'm on. Can we do a small canary (internal + partners) before flipping latest?
jordan: +1 for canary. Also we should hold a dist-tag 'beta' and only tag 'latest' after 2 hours smoke.
maya: Agreed. Proposal: publish to 'beta' at T+0, run smoke for 30m, roll to 10% via feature flag users at T+30, then 100% at T+120 if no regressions.
lee: For version pinning: publish as x.y.z-beta1 for py wheels and @next for npm dist-tag. Then retag to x.y.z and 'latest' after GA. Keeps installs deterministic.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: publish job queued for 2026-03-23T02:15:00Z. Job id: jb-171111-88. Will emit events: published->smoke->tag-latest. Use --dry-run to validate before push.
ariane: Release notes: include breaking change in RetryClient behavior + example snippet. I'll PR docs now: https://github.com/redwood/inference-sdk/pull/1298
sam: Rollback criteria suggestion: any >1% error increase in core API surface OR any signed checksum mismatch on wheels/npm. If observed, yank dist-tag and open emergency revert.
jordan: Also watch telemetry: tokenization mismatches, invalid import errors for ts build. If those spike, abort and yank.
maya: Emergency revert steps: 1) yank npm dist-tag, 2) unpublish wheel (if necessary) and re-publish last-known-good with same semver? avoid reusing semver — instead push x.y.z+rollback. 3) update release notes / incident thread.
lee: Note on signing: ensure GPG signatures for wheels are present and checksum is uploaded to releases. CI will block if missing.
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: smoke step completed at T+28m: all internal smoke tests passed. Canary rollout to 10% starting. Monitoring hooks: /integrations/release-metrics and /alerts/sdk-regressions enabled.
maya: Thanks — will monitor. If we see any red flags we'll stop the rollout and follow rollback steps. I'll post final release notes blurb once PR merges. :rocket:
